name: @stvor/client
description: TypeScript client for the Stvor verification API: commit → verify → settle, with offline receipt verification and configurable fail mode. Stvor never touches funds.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --format esm && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.cjs --format cjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
